summary: Examples of regex_escape for Python, POSIX basic and POSIX extended regexes.
questions: How do I escape ]]^ for a POSIX basic regex?

answer_card.title: regex_escape examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
safe_for_regex: "{{ '^f.*o(.*)$' | regex_escape() }}"
# => '\^f\.\*o\(\.\*\)\$'

safe_for_posix_basic: "{{ ']]^' | regex_escape(re_type='posix_basic') }}"

safe_for_posix_extended: "{{ '^f.*o(.*)$' | regex_escape(re_type='posix_extended') }}"
```
